title: NostalgicVerse Guides Master Dataset
description: Canonical structured source data for hardware preservation guides, emulation setups, and archival procedures.

guides.title: CRT Display Calibration & 240p Test Suite Setup
guides.summary: A methodical walkthrough for calibrating consumer CRTs, PVMs, and BVMs using the 240p Test Suite. Covers linearity, raster geometry, convergence, and black level clamping.

guides.title: Optical Drive Laser Calibration & Potentiometer Tuning
guides.summary: Calibrating CD and DVD optical pickup units using digital multimeters and oscilloscope RF eye-pattern analysis to restore reliable disc read timing without burning out laser diodes.

guides.title: Optical Drive Emulation (ODE) Architecture & Implementation
guides.summary: Replacing failing mechanical disc drives with solid-state Optical Drive Emulators (ODEs). Explores bus timings, DMA streaming protocols, and preserving original laser assemblies.

guides.title: Analog RGB Signal Routing: SCART, Component & Clean Sync
guides.summary: Understanding native analog video outputs across classic hardware. Covers RGBS vs RGsB vs YPbPr, composite sync (CSYNC) attenuation, 75-ohm impedance matching, and avoiding ground hum.

guides.title: Electrolytic Capacitor Maintenance & Leak Prevention
guides.system: Game Gear / PC Engine / Amiga / Xbox
guides.summary: Identifying SMD and through-hole capacitor leakage, neutralizing caustic electrolyte residue on PCB traces, and selecting appropriate low-ESR polymer and ceramic replacements.

guides.title: SRAM Battery Replacement & Save Preservation
guides.system: NES / SNES / Mega Drive / Game Boy
guides.summary: Safely replacing CR2032 and CR1616 coin cell batteries in cartridge hardware using tabbed cells or battery holders while backing up saved game states via non-destructive dumping.

guides.title: Controller Input Latency & USB Polling Rate Optimization
guides.summary: Measuring end-to-end controller latency from button press to display scanline. Explains 1000Hz USB polling, daemon overrides, and low-latency microcontroller adapter firmware.

guides.title: Cycle-Accurate Latency Reduction via Runahead & Preemptive Frames
guides.summary: Configuring deterministic state rollback algorithms (Runahead) to eliminate emulation input latency, matching or exceeding the responsiveness of original CRT hardware.

guides.title: PlayStation 2 Internal HDD & Free McBoot Archival Setup
guides.summary: Configuring internal 3.5-inch SATA hard drives via the official Network Adapter to run verified archival disc images without wear on the mechanical DVD laser mechanism.

guides.title: Sega Dreamcast GD-ROM Emulation & Power Supply Thermal Mod
guides.summary: Installing a solid-state GDEMU board into VA1 Dreamcast hardware, adding a 3D-printed airflow duct, and mitigating 12V rail heat buildup on the stock power supply.

guides.title: Eliminating Audio Hum, Ground Loops & Power Supply Noise
guides.system: Mega Drive / Genesis / Saturn / Analogue Setups
guides.summary: Diagnosing 50Hz/60Hz mains hum, switching power supply coil whine, and ground loop interference in complex multi-console audio and video switches.

guides.title: IPS Backlight Modification for Handheld Platforms
guides.system: Game Boy Advance / Game Boy Color
guides.summary: Installing modern high-density IPS and OLED laminated display kits into reflective-LCD handhelds with brightness control wire soldering and power regulation checks.

guides.title: Optical Media Preservation: Redump Verification Standards
guides.summary: Dumping optical game discs to byte-accurate ISO/BIN/CUE image files using compatible Plextor/LG drives and verifying hashes against international Redump checksum databases.

guides.title: Cartridge Contact Restoration & Oxide Decontamination
guides.summary: Best practices for chemically removing copper and gold oxide from cartridge edge connectors using 99% isopropyl alcohol, DeoxIT contact cleaner, and non-abrasive swabs.
